verdict: WSUS clients are restarting automatically without user notification after updates install. The client is missing Windows Installer 3.1 or later, which the deadline-driven restart flow requires for proper notification handling.
fix: Install Windows Installer 3.1+ (redistributable) on affected clients. On modern Windows (10+, Server 2016+), MSI 5.0+ ships in-box so this only affects legacy holdouts. For interim mitigation until the MSI update rolls out, deploy the registry keys that enable `NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers` under `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU`.
